character: Dolomite resort town in the Veneto that co-hosted the 2026 Winter Olympics (Milano Cortina), with skiing split between Tofana-Socrepes, Faloria-Cristallo and Cinque Torri-Lagazuoi. From the Lagazuoi refuge (2,752 m) the long Armentarola run descends towards Alta Badia.
learning: Faloria-Cristallo-Mietres is described as suitable for all abilities, including children (search summary); Tofana has the more demanding runs (Canalone, Schuss).
